name: DLA-benchmark
description: DLA-benchmark evaluates document layout analysis models on digitized manuscript and printed-page images, measuring ability to detect, classify and segment page elements (paragraphs, headings, figures, etc.). It is aimed at assessing OCR pre-processing and document understanding pipelines for complex or historical documents. The benchmark emphasizes structured layout recovery and element-level classification accuracy.
reputation: A niche benchmark used in digital humanities and document-analysis research with modest community adoption.
